hypothesis: Describe whether ranking the retained original highlighted pool by its recorded standardized gap score changes selected outcomes at capacities 6, 10 and 20, with an abstaining control.
not_equivalent_to: A full-board website strategy, probability ranking, EV selection, new original recommendations or prospective validation.
source: Same authenticated 2026 Weeks 4-8 original archive picks, lines and frozen statistical grades used by ORIGINAL_LEANS_REPORT_V1.json.
eligibility: Original highlighted membership, matching player/game, non-late original record, dk/sleeper real-line source. Pending and unresolved selections stay selected and visible.
dedup: One record per season/week/player/game/category; conflicts fail. Original source pick pool may already reflect side quotas; disclose this restriction.
ranking: Descending absolute ORIGINAL recorded score; never recompute score from newer forecasts. Ties use stable game/player/category/side/line string.
threshold_note: The score-2 abstention rule is fixed here for an exposed descriptive check; it is not tuned, known optimal or a live release policy.
metrics: Hits, misses, pushes, DNP, pending, unresolved, abstention/coverage; category/side/week breakdown; no probabilities or returns without supported original values.
